test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct option is: **2) because of.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Because of"** is the correct choice here because it introduces the reason or cause for the people being prone to fatal diseases.
 
• The sentence implies that despite becoming health-conscious, people are still at risk because of their simple lifestyle habits.
 
• The phrase **"because of"** indicates the cause of the problem (fatal diseases), which is linked to their lifestyle habits.

The correct sentence is: *"Though people are becoming health-conscious these days, **because of **__simple lifestyle habits they are prone to fatal diseases."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Why the other options are incorrect:

 
• **Option 1: "for"** – The preposition "for" would not work here because it does not express causality in the correct way. "For" typically indicates a purpose or intended outcome but does not serve as a cause, so it doesn't fit the meaning in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "because"** – The word "because" would be incorrect in this sentence because it is typically used to introduce a clause, not a noun phrase. Since the phrase following the blank ("simple lifestyle habits") is a noun phrase, "because of" is needed rather than just "because".
 
• **Option 4: "but" **– "But" is used to show contrast, but the sentence is not contrasting two opposing ideas. Instead, it is explaining the cause (lifestyle habits) for the result (being prone to fatal diseases). Therefore, "but" would not fit logically in this context.
